package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"net/http"
)

func (h LessonHandler) ResolveRevision(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	value, err := h.RevisionsUC.Resolve(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID"))
	writeRevision(w, value, err)
}
func (h LessonHandler) GetRevision(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	value, err := h.RevisionsUC.Get(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "revisionID"))
	writeRevision(w, value, err)
}
func writeRevision(w http.ResponseWriter, v *domain.LessonRevision, err error) {
	if err != nil {
		status := http.StatusInternalServerError
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			status = http.StatusNotFound
		}
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			status = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity
		}
		http.Error(w, http.StatusText(status), status)
		return
	}
	tasks := make([]taskResponse, 0, len(v.Content.Tasks))
	for _, task := range v.Content.Tasks {
		tasks = append(tasks, buildTaskResponse(&task.Task, task.Tests, task.StarterFiles, true, true, nil))
	}
	content := map[string]any{"title": v.Content.Title, "excerpt": v.Content.Excerpt, "description": v.Content.Description, "translations": v.Content.Translations, "examples": v.Content.Examples, "tasks": tasks}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"schema": v.Schema, "lesson_id": v.LessonID, "lesson_revision_id": v.LessonRevisionID, "content": content, "activities": v.Activities, "created_at": v.CreatedAt})
}
